entries.def:
§ Idalah = "memorial of God"
a town in Zebulun between Shimron and Bethlehem

v
1) (Qal) to throw lots, cast lots
n
2) love, loving-one, friend
one dearly loved, beloved one, object of love

top.gloss: i will give thanks to you
i will give thanks to him

entries.def:
1) to throw, shoot, cast
1a) (Qal) to shoot (arrows)
1b) (Piel) to cast, cast down, throw down
1c) (Hiphil)
1c1) to give thanks, laud, praise
1c2) to confess, confess (the name of God)
1d) (Hithpael)
1d1) to confess (sin)
1d2) to give thanks
Aramaic equivalent: ye.da (יְדָא "to praise" H3029)
